topic.title: İş Toplantısı
topic.description: Gündemi takip et, fikrini sun, geri bildirim ver.

lesson.title: İş Toplantısında Konuşmak
lesson.intro: Bu derste bir iş toplantısında gündemi takip etmeyi, fikir sunmayı ve başkasının söylediğini aktarmayı öğreneceksin.

words.example_en: The meeting has been postponed to Friday.
Can we get some feedback on this proposal?
words.example_tr: Bu teklif hakkında geri bildirim alabilir miyiz?

words.example_en: All stakeholders agreed on the plan.
Could you elaborate on that point?
I'll send the minutes after the meeting.
We need to reach a consensus.

phrases.english: Could you elaborate on that point?
We need to reach a consensus.
Let's postpone this decision until next week.
Can we get some feedback on this proposal?
phrases.turkish: Bu teklif hakkında geri bildirim alabilir miyiz?

grammar.title: Reported Speech (said that...)
grammar.explanation: Birinin söylediğini aktarırken 'said that' kullanılır ve genelde zaman bir adım geriye kayar: 'I am busy' → 'She said that she was busy.' 'We will finish it' → 'He said that they would finish it.'
examples: She said that she was busy.
He said that they would finish it on time.
They said that the budget had increased.

examples.english: The meeting has been postponed to Friday.
All stakeholders agreed on the plan.
I'll send the minutes after the meeting.

questions.explanation: Reported speech'te zaman bir adım geri kayar: is → was.
"Let's go through the agenda." doğal iş İngilizcesi kalıbı.

choices.text: He said that they would finish it on time.
He said that they will finish it on time.
He said they would finished it on time.

questions.prompt: They said that the budget ___ increased.
"Bu teklif hakkında geri bildirim alabilir miyiz?" sorusunun doğrusunu seç.
questions.explanation: "Can we get some feedback on this proposal?" doğru kelime sırası.

choices.text: Can we get some feedback on this proposal?
Can we get feedback this proposal on?
Can get we some feedback on this proposal?

scenario.title: Toplantıda konuşmak
scenario.task: Toplantıda birinin söylediğini aktarırken Reported Speech kullan: 'She said that...'

steps.speaker: Colleague
steps.line: Good morning everyone, shall we start?

options.text: Sure, let's go through the agenda.

options.feedback: Eksik cümle; tam kalıbı kullan: 'Let's go through the agenda.'
Türkçeden birebir çeviri, eksik edat; doğrusu 'Let's go through the agenda.'

steps.speaker: Colleague
steps.line: First item: the new proposal. Any thoughts?
steps.line_tr: İlk madde: yeni teklif. Görüşü olan var mı?

options.text: Could you elaborate on that point?

options.feedback: Emir gibi duruyor, kaba; 'Could you elaborate...?' kullan.

options.text: Could you elaborate about that point?
options.feedback: 'Elaborate' 'on' ile kullanılır, 'about' ile değil: 'Could you elaborate on that point?'

steps.speaker: Colleague
steps.line: Sure. John said that the budget had increased.

options.text: I see. Can we get some feedback on this proposal?

options.feedback: Eksik cümle; tam soru kur: 'Can we get some feedback on this proposal?'

options.text: Can we got some feedback on this proposal?
options.feedback: Fiil formu yanlış; doğrusu 'Can we get some feedback...?'

steps.speaker: Colleague
steps.line: Good idea. But we're running out of time today.
steps.line_tr: İyi fikir. Ama bugün vaktimiz azalıyor.

options.text: Let's postpone this decision until next week.
Let's leave this decision to next week.
options.feedback: Doğal değil; dersteki kalıp 'Let's postpone this decision until next week.'

options.text: We must decide now, no more talk.
options.feedback: Kaba ve baskıcı duruyor; nazikçe erteleme öner.

steps.speaker: Colleague
steps.line: Agreed. We need to reach a consensus before Friday though.
steps.line_tr: Kabul. Ama Cuma'dan önce bir uzlaşıya varmamız gerekiyor.

options.text: Understood, I'll follow up by email.
I will follow up on email.
options.feedback: 'by email' kalıbı kullanılır, 'on email' değil: 'I'll follow up by email.'
Eksik cümle; tam kalıbı kullan: 'I'll follow up by email.'
